title: Jason Greensocks - Stop Playin
htmlContent:
Jason Greensocks drops a new single called "Stop Playin". The sound is innovative and packed with mass appeal, that is packed with incredible melodies that you hope never end. It’s truly a superb record from the vocal performance, the lyrics, and the production that makes you wish you can enjoy it for a little longer.
